question: Kiran Nadar was conferred with the highest civilian award of which country in April 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**France**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kiran Nadar** was conferred with the highest civilian award of **France** in April 2023.
 
• This award is known as the **Legion of Honour** or **Légion d'Honneur** in French.
 
• The award was established by **Napoleon Bonaparte** in 1802 and is the highest French order of merit for military and civil merits.
 
• Kiran Nadar is recognized for her significant contributions to the arts and philanthropy.
 
• The award ceremony took place in a grand event attended by dignitaries and notable personalities from various fields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kiran Nadar** is a prominent Indian art collector and philanthropist.
 
• She is the founder of the **Kiran Nadar Museum of Art**, which is a private museum exhibiting modern and contemporary works from India and the subcontinent.
 
• Her efforts have significantly contributed to promoting Indian art on the global stage.
 
• The **Legion of Honour** is awarded in various degrees, including Chevalier (Knight), Officier (Officer), Commandeur (Commander), Grand Officier (Grand Officer), and Grand-Croix (Grand Cross).
